notablePrerequisites: Master Transmuter does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Seat of the Synod by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Master Transmuter by paying {U}, tapping it and returning Seat of the Synod from the battlefield to your hand, putting Seat of the Synod from your hand onto the battlefield.
Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping Master Transmuter.
Repeat.
